test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Identify the error in the following sentence.**

We are assured of the fact that Siben might good be the best cook to prepare chicken curry for our lunch.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is** "good."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in the usage of the phrase **"might good be."**
 
• The error is the placement of **"good."**
 
• It should come after
